project: Cajita de Luna / 5. Inteligencia documental / Docling

target.comparison: Measured bytes of complete isolated Docling candidate directory, including quantized weights, local config/tokenizer/processor assets, manifest and runtime shim

method.text: CPU adaptation of randomized-SVD-initialized, row-scaled binary low-rank compression inspired by NanoQuant
method.vision_and_connector: Row-scaled binary sign quantization with sparse FP16 residual outliers, inspired by Bi-VLM
method.note: These are explicitly adapted methods, not the unmodified upstream CUDA/GPU implementations and not a claim of equivalent model quality.

acceptance_gates: CUSTOSZ V9 artifact, mission and authorization pins verified
all five existing local resource files match pinned size and SHA-256
official model repository and revision downloaded without mutating existing model artifacts
candidate file manifest and tensor shapes reconcile to the pinned architecture
measured entire candidate directory is <= 30000000 bytes
candidate loads offline from its own local directory with no missing/random model parameters
real CPU startup smoke performs image preprocessing and generates nonempty output
launch, checkpoint, event chain and GitHub branch files are synchronized and hash-reconciled
model quality equivalence and canonical certification remain NOT_GRANTED until separately evaluated

preservation.calibre_assets: Preserve both Calibre packages; do not delete or misrepresent them as included in the Docling model bundle.
preservation.docling_slim: Preserve wheel unchanged; keep registered dependency status explicit.
